name: guards
description: Blocks AI attribution in commits and PRs, secrets in commands and files, and edits on main or master

attribution.title: No-attribution guard
attribution.description: Deny git commit and gh pr create/edit whose text credits an AI

secrets.title: Secret guard
secrets.description: Deny commands and file writes that contain a likely secret value

branch.title: Branch guard
branch.description: Deny file edits in a git repository checked out on main or master
